title: Hushfrost Pass - Aurora Over Ice
_note: Option C sparser ambient / Frost-forward. gbc 4-voice band. emotional/ambient. Suspended C minor with a lifted, aurora-bright color (sus2/sus4, Eb softened by Bb/F), 70 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars. Very high glassy chimes, sparse and shimmering — more sparkle than tune. pulse12 suspended arpeggio that sweeps up and back down like an aurora ribbon (wide swoosh of arpeggiated motion). Soft sustained low bass, mostly still. Drums almost absent — a single soft hat shimmer at the loop seam, no heartbeat. Vesper motif as an upward shimmer: the rising leap G4->C5->D5 becomes the bottom of an ascending sparkle run rather than a melody, vast and impersonal. Ties timbrally to Pale Vault Glacier. Last bar G->C pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
